body:
> Verify that an additional iteration of a key derivation function is performed, using a salt value that is secret and known only to the verifier. This salt value **, if used,** SHALL be generated by an approved random bit generator [SP 800-90Ar1] and provide at least the minimum security strength specified in the latest revision of SP 800-131A.

As this is a requirement for Level 2+, and the whole point of this control is to add a secret that is stored outside of the credential database, the "if used" seems unnecessary. If not used, this control becomes meaningless unless I'm missing something.
title: V2.4.5 - remove unnecessary ", if used,"
